name: Teamhood
desc: Visual project management for boards, tasks, and timelogs in Teamhood.

actions.name: create_item
actions.description: Create a new item (task) in a Teamhood board.

actions.name: update_item
actions.description: Update an existing Teamhood item. Only fields you fill in will be updated.

actions.name: get_item
actions.description: Retrieve a single Teamhood item by ID.

actions.name: find_items
actions.description: Search for Teamhood items using filters.

actions.name: create_row
actions.description: Create a new horizontal swimlane row on a Teamhood board.

actions.name: list_users
actions.description: List all users in your Teamhood account.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_item
triggers.description: Fires when a new item (task) is created in Teamhood.

triggers.name: updated_item
triggers.description: Fires when an existing Teamhood item is modified.

triggers.name: completed_item
triggers.description: Fires when a Teamhood item is marked as completed.
